article.headline: Forte scores 25, South Dakota downs Denver 86-79
article.description: — Chase Forte scored 25 points as South Dakota beat Denver 86-79 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Forte scores 25, South Dakota downs Denver 86-79
article.story: DENVER -- — Chase Forte scored 25 points as South Dakota beat Denver 86-79 on Thursday night. Forte also contributed six rebounds and three steals for the Coyotes (14-10, 5-4 Summit League). Quandre Bullock added 20 points while shooting 7 for 11 (1 for 4 from 3-point range) and 5 of 8 from the free-throw line while they also had five rebounds. Isaac Bruns had 18 points and shot 6 of 13 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 6 from the foul line. The Pioneers (8-17, 2-8) were led in scoring by DeAndre Craig, who finished with 19 points and six rebounds. Pedro Lopez-Sanvicente added 12 points, six rebounds and two steals for Denver. Isaiah Addo-Ankrah finished with 10 points. NEXT UP Both teams next play Saturday. South Dakota visits Oral Roberts and Denver plays St. Thomas (MN) at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
